author_notes: Rebuild the #portfolio 'Filter by stack' control on the Davina Griss React portfolio into the project grid's own native category filter. A row of discipline tabs (All / Angular / React / TypeScript) filters the six project cards and drives a live count readout ('Showing 2 of 6 · React'); a compact 'Currently browsing' focus echo repeats the selected stack beside the About intro and the Experience timeline so the browsing context follows the reader down the single-page portfolio. The filter tab row must wrap on a 390px phone (no horizontal overflow), the filtered card grid must stay a clean responsive Bootstrap row with the active tab legible, and clicking a tab must re-derive BOTH the shown cards and the count readout (not just move the active-tab highlight). This exercises the repo's own component boundaries (Projects.js, App.scss, a shared StackFocus component, and the project JSON), the beige/dark polaroid theme, the Bootstrap grid, and the react-scripts build.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the hero and header at 1440px with no horizontal overflow.
tablet_initial captures the portfolio at 834px; the filter and grid stay readable.
mobile_initial captures the page at 390px, where the filter tab row must wrap and stay within the viewport with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_portfolio scrolls to the #portfolio section and captures the 'Filter by stack' tab row, the 'Showing all 6 projects' readout, and the six project cards (All filter) laid out cleanly.
mobile_portfolio scrolls to the #portfolio section at 390px and captures the tab row and card grid reflowed within the viewport with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_react captures the #portfolio section after clicking the 'React' stack tab: the grid re-filters to the two React projects and the readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 6 · React'.
desktop_about captures the #about section; the 'Currently browsing' focus echo is present here (cross-surface continuity).
desktop_experience captures the #resume experience timeline; the 'Currently browsing' focus echo is present here (cross-surface continuity).
required_content: A real 'Filter by stack' control (tabs All / Angular / React / TypeScript) sits above the #portfolio project card grid; clicking a stack tab re-renders the project cards to the matching stack.
The control shows a genuine result count that re-derives from the active filter (e.g. 'Showing all 6 projects' becomes 'Showing 2 of 6 · React' when the React tab is selected).

A compact 'Currently browsing' focus echo repeats the selected stack beside the About intro AND the Experience timeline as well as the portfolio, so the browsing context follows the reader down the single-page portfolio.

The filter tab row and the filtered card grid stay within the 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal overflow and lay out cleanly (tabs wrap, cards keep their columns rather than spilling, overlapping, or clipping).

The filter adopts the portfolio's own beige/dark polaroid theme and gold (#AE944F) accent, and the active tab is clearly legible (not dark-on-dark) — an on-brand stack filter, not an off-palette or broken control.

The Davina Griss persona stays intact: the hero, the six project cards with their images and Project Delivery Metadata chips, the details modal, the language switcher, the skills grid, and the experience timeline all continue to tell one story, and all captured states emit no runtime console or network errors.
design_constraints: The stack filter lives in the #portfolio section as a row of discipline tabs above the existing project card grid, styled in the repo's beige/dark polaroid theme; it is NOT a bolted-on metric-tile strip in a gap.
The tab row (.stackfilter__tabs) must wrap on a 390px mobile viewport so the document does not exceed the viewport by more than 24px.

The filtered project grid (.stackfilter__grid) must remain the original responsive Bootstrap row: cards keep their column widths, do not overlap or clip, and the active tab stays legible (no dark-on-dark contrast failure).

Clicking a stack tab must re-derive the shown cards AND the count readout from the selected stack, so the readout reads 'Showing N of 6 · <Stack>' matching the cards on screen; the active-tab highlight moving alone is not sufficient.

The 'Currently browsing' focus echo (StackFocus) must render on the portfolio, About, and Experience surfaces; keep the language switcher, theme icons, project images, modal slider, technology list, skills section, and vertical timeline exactly as they are.

change_completion: The #portfolio section renders the 'Filter by stack' tabs (All / Angular / React / TypeScript) above the six project cards with a live count readout.
Clicking the React tab filters the grid to the React projects and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · React'; clicking All restores all six.
A control that only moves the active-tab highlight while the grid and readout stay frozen on 'Showing all 6 projects' is NOT accepted.
design_consistency: The filter tabs, focus echo, and card grid use the repo's beige/dark polaroid theme and Bootstrap grid; the portfolio still reads as the original Davina Griss React portfolio.
The active tab is legible (gold-on-beige), the cards do not overlap or clip, and desktop / tablet layout of every other section is unchanged.
responsive: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and the desktop portfolio state render with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_initial and mobile_portfolio render with the tab row wrapped and no horizontal overflow on a 390px viewport.
regression: No regression: all six projects preserve their existing titles, dates, images, and Project Delivery Metadata chips, and the modal slider, technology list, language switcher, theme icons, skills grid, and vertical experience timeline are preserved exactly as in the original build (desktop and tablet layout unchanged).
No regression is introduced at runtime: no new console errors and no failed network requests appear on any captured state, and the original hero, section order, and footer are preserved.

problem_statement: The Dorota1997/react-frontend-dev-portfolio single-page developer portfolio (rebranded 'Davina Griss') shows its work as a card grid in the #portfolio section. Build the grid its own native 'Filter by stack' control: a row of discipline tabs (All / Angular / React / TypeScript) above the six project cards that filters the cards and drives a live count readout, plus a compact 'Currently browsing' focus echo that repeats the selected stack beside the About intro and the Experience timeline. On a 390px phone the tab row must wrap so the page does not scroll horizontally; the filtered grid must stay a clean responsive Bootstrap row (cards must not overlap or clip and the active tab must stay legible); and clicking a tab must re-derive BOTH the shown cards and the count readout from the selected stack (reading 'Showing 2 of 6 · React' for React), not merely move the active-tab highlight. Keep the beige/dark polaroid theme, the project images, the details modal, the language switcher, the skills section, and the vertical experience timeline exactly as they are. A control whose tab row overflows mobile, whose grid overlaps or clips its cards, whose focus echo is missing from the About/Experience surfaces, or whose readout stays frozen on 'Showing all 6 projects' after a click does not count as done.
